description: Find current or former Swiss Parliament affiliation records by name, council, canton, party, or parliamentary group; list a committee’s members with committeeId, its current composition or with asOf its composition on a past day; or find the members who declare an interest with interest. membership defaults to current; former selects inactive records and all omits the activity filter. committeeId returns one row per published membership with its committee function and takes membership current only; with asOf, rows carry the names, council, canton, party, and group recorded for that membership, plus its committee dates. interest returns one row per matching declaration: the declarant’s member record, filtered by the other inputs, plus the declaration. query matches a substring of a published first, last, or official name. Use each record’s personNumber with chparl_get_member for identity, full council terms, committees, and declared interests. Follow nextOffset with the same filters.

asOf.description: Optional day, YYYY-MM-DD, or a date-time as this server returns one (2014-03-03T00:00:00.000), read as its day; requires committeeId. Lists the memberships open on that day in the published committee history, a membership’s last day included, so a person holds two rows on a day their function changed. council, cantonId, partyId, and groupId filter the affiliation recorded for each membership. History starts per committee, 1995-12-04 for standing committees; a day after today in Switzerland is rejected.

cantonId.description: Optional Canton identifier from chparl_list_reference topic cantons.

committeeId.description: Optional CommitteeNumber from chparl_list_reference topic committees. Lists that committee’s members, one row per membership: its current roster, or its roster on asOf. A sub-committee has its own number and roster. Other filters narrow the roster.

council.description: N or S; exact German, French, and Italian council names are accepted. Resolve codes with chparl_list_reference topic councils.

groupId.description: Optional ParlGroupNumber from chparl_list_reference topic groups.

interest.description: Optional substring of a declared interest name, such as an organisation. Returns one row per matching declaration: the declarant’s member record plus the declaration. The match ignores case and accents but is otherwise literal, on a name declared once and never translated (Groupe de réflexion Groupe Mutuel, Gruppo di riflessione Groupe Mutuel), so search the name as declared in each language; an empty result does not establish that no member has a tie. A newly sworn-in member’s declarations can be missing until the member record is published. Cannot be combined with committeeId or asOf.

language.description: Metadata language: de (default), fr, or it; uppercase is accepted.

limit.description: Requested page size, default 20, effective maximum 100 with notice.

membership.description: current (default), former, or all MemberCouncil records; with interest, the declarant’s record. Current records include the Federal Council (councilId 99) and the Federal Chancellor (councilId 98) beside the parliamentarians. With committeeId, only current is accepted.

offset.description: Starting row offset: MemberCouncil records, committee memberships with committeeId, or declarations with interest; continue with returned nextOffset.

partyId.description: Optional Party identifier from chparl_list_reference topic parties.

query.description: Optional name substring, trimmed without changing internal punctuation or diacritics.

name: chparl_search_members

committeeFound.description: Committee searches only: whether the committee exists, independently of published members.

effectiveFilters.description: Normalized search filters and resolved defaults.

asOf.description: Effective roster day, YYYY-MM-DD; absent for the current roster.

committeeId.description: Effective CommitteeNumber whose roster is listed.

interest.description: Effective trimmed substring of a declared interest name.

limit.description: Effective requested record count after clamping.

membership.description: current filters Active true; former false; all omits Active, except on interest searches, where it requires a published declarant record with either value. Committee rosters send no Active filter.

effectiveLimit.description: Effective requested page size after clamping.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `incompatible_fields`: committeeId is combined with membership former or all, asOf is supplied without committeeId, or interest is combined with committeeId or asOf. `as_of_in_future`: asOf is after today’s date in Switzerland. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament returned HTTP 429. `request_too_long`: The text filters, query or interest, make the URL-encoded Parliament request longer than its 2048-byte query-string limit. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: How to discover a valid committeeId when the committee was not found.

members.description: Rows delivered on this page: MemberCouncil affiliation records; one committee membership per row on committee searches, as recorded on that day with asOf; or one declaration per row with interest.

items.description: One published MemberCouncil affiliation record; on committee searches, one committee membership; on interest searches, one declaration with its declarant’s record. On asOf rosters, sourceUrl cites the MemberCommitteeHistory record, names, council, canton, party, and group are those recorded for that membership, officialName and memberCouncilId come from the current MemberCouncil record, and active, joinedDate, and leftDate are omitted.

active.description: Published activity flag; absent means unknown.

committeeFunctionId.description: Committee searches only: published CommitteeFunction code, such as 1 Mitglied, 2 Präsident/in, or 6 Vizepräsident/in.

committeeJoinedDate.description: asOf rosters only: the day this committee membership began, without an inferred timezone.

committeeLeftDate.description: asOf rosters only: the last day of this committee membership, when published; it can lie in the future.

groupAbbreviation.description: Published parliamentary-group abbreviation for this record.

groupId.description: Published parliamentary-group identifier for this record.

groupName.description: Published parliamentary-group name for this record.

interest.description: interest searches only: the declaration this row reports, as chparl_get_member section interests returns it, with its own id and sourceUrl.

dateFrom.description: Published start date (DateFrom) of this declaration, without an inferred timezone.

modifiedAt.description: Published modification timestamp without an inferred timezone.

paid.description: Published paid flag; absent means unknown.

sourceUrl.description: HTTPS OData URL for this interest record.

joinedDate.description: Council term joining date, without an inferred timezone.

leftDate.description: Council term leaving date, when published.

metadataLanguage.description: Selected metadata row language, not a translation claim.

partyAbbreviation.description: Published party abbreviation for this record.

partyId.description: Published party identifier for this record.

partyName.description: Published party name for this record.

personNumber.description: PersonNumber used by every member-profile lookup.

sourceUrl.description: HTTPS OData URL for this exact source record.

nextOffset.description: Starting offset plus delivered rows; absent when exhausted.

notice.description: Combined clamping, empty-result, empty-roster, or past-end guidance.

provenance.description: Attribution, publication status, and source download dates.

officialPublication.description: This server is an unofficial reproduction of the source.

sources.description: Every HTTP response contributing data, or each static source snapshot.

items.description: A source used to produce this result.

retrievedAt.description: Actual UTC download timestamp, or the date of a static source snapshot.

url.description: HTTPS source response or official snapshot document URL.

returnedCount.description: Number of rows delivered: MemberCouncil records, committee memberships on committee searches, or declarations on interest searches.

totalCount.description: Exact whole-query row count when supplied upstream, in the unit of returnedCount.
